content: Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, bwiɑ ɡɑɑ yɑ koo yɑri yu kɑ Dɑfidin yɛnuɡibu kɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɡibun torɑnu wɔkɑ.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, nɛ, Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni kon bũnun yĩsinu kpeerɑsiɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ kpɑ bu ku rɑɑ mɑɑ nu yɑɑyɑ. Kon mɑɑ nɛn sɔmɔ weesuɡii be bɑ bũu sɑ̃ɑrun kĩru mɔ mi wunɑ.

Goo ù n ɡɑri weesuɡii mɔ̀, win tundo kɑ win mɛro bɑ koo nùn sɔ̃wɑ bu nɛɛ, kɑɑ ɡbi. Domi ɑ weesu mɔ̀wɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yĩsiru. Kpɑ tundo wi, kɑ mɛro wi, bu nùn tɑkobi sɔku bu ɡo sɑnɑm mɛ u ɡɑri yi mɔ̀.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, Gusunɔn sɔmɔbu bɑ koo sekuru wɑ ben kɑ̃si weesuɡinun sɔ̃. Bɑ̀ n ɡɑri mɔ̀, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ yɑbe sɑnsuɡinu sebumɔ bu kɑ tɔmbu nɔni wɔ̃ke.
Ben bɑɑwure u koo nɛɛwɑ, u ǹ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ. Wi, ɡbɑɑ wukowɑ. Domi bɑ nùn dwɑwɑ sɑɑ win piiburun di.
Bɑ̀ n nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mɑnɑ u sere mɛɛrɑ yeni wɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ win nɔmɑɔ, kpɑ u wisi u nɛɛ, u ye wɑwɑ win bɔrɔ kĩnɑsibun yɛnuɔ.
Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u nɛɛ,

content.text: tɑkobi, ɑ nɛn kpɑro wi nɑ kuɑ nɛn bɔ̃ɔ wɔrio.
A nùn ɡoowo kpɑ yɑ̃ɑnu nu yɑrinɑ,
kpɑ n ni nu kun dɑm mɔ wɔri.

content: U mɑɑ nɛɛ, bɑ̀ n tem mɛn tɔmbu bɔnu kuɑ subɑ itɑ, yen subɑ yiru yɑ koo ɡbi kpɑ sube tee teni tu tiɑrɑ.

Kon sube tee te dɔ̃ɔ doke kpɑ n tu sɔwɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ sii ɡeesu sɔwe. Kon tu sɔwɑwɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ wurɑ sɔwe. Tɑ koo nɛn yĩsiru soku kpɑ n tu wurɑri. Kon tu sɔ̃ n nɛɛ, tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛn tɔmbu. Kpɑ ten tii tu mɑɑ nɛɛ, nɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Gusunɔ ten Yinni.
